request.question: The wheel plant is closed. Who should we order from, and why not WaveCrest?

answer:
**VF Vendor 08** (SAP supplier USSU-VSF08) is the best alternate supplier for the BKS-400 AT Wheels; it closes the supply gap entirely and meets all sourcing policy requirements with a 93.1 audit score, 21-day lead time, 100% capacity, and valid certificate to 31 Dec 2027. **WaveCrest Labs is blocked** because its audit score of 89.4 falls below the quality bar of 90.

| Supplier | Status | Audit Score | Lead Time (days) | Capacity (% demand) | Certificate Valid To | Why Blocked/Candidate |
|----------|--------|-------------|------------------|---------------------|----------------------|----------------------|
| **VF Vendor 08** (USSU-VSF08) | **Candidate** | 93.1 | 21 | 100% | 2027-12-31 | Best alternate; fits within 40.2 days of cover |
| **WaveCrest Labs** (USSU-VSF02) | **Blocked** | **89.4** | 18 | 100% | 2027-05-31 | **Below quality bar of 90** |
| EV Parts Inc. (USSU-VSF01) | Candidate | 91.2 | 35 | 60% | 2027-02-28 | Partial capacity, slower |
| VF Vendor 06 (USSU-VSF06) | Blocked | 94.0 | 28 | 100% | **2026-08-31** | Certificate expired |

**Why it matters:** The Kwinana wheel plant closure (cyclone, 60 days from 22 Oct 2026) puts 40 haul trucks, 49,000 t/day ore, and USD 105.1 million revenue at risk if no action is taken by stockout on 1 Dec 2026. Switching to VF Vendor 08 eliminates the 19.8-day gap and revenue risk.

**Next step:** Issue purchase order to VF Vendor 08 today and confirm stock availability and delivery schedule to cover the 60-day closure window.
